title: Far-right groups and police clash in Madrid over deadly train crash
seoTitle: Madrid protest over deadly train crash

tea.why: Protesters expressed anger over a deadly train collision that claimed 68 lives.
tea.want: Demonstrators demanded the resignation of Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez and transport minister Oscar Puente.
tea.changed: Oct 28: Protesters and police clashed outside the Ministry of Transport after a demonstration near Nuevos Ministerios.

summary: Demonstrations erupted in Madrid following a deadly train collision near Toledo that resulted in 68 deaths and over 100 injuries. A gathering began near Nuevos Ministerios at 8pm before moving to the Ministry of Transport, involving far-right groups such as Revuelta. The protest began peacefully before escalating as participants overturned bins, set fires, and chanted slogans demanding the resignation of Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez and transport minister Oscar Puente. Riot control officers responded by deploying pepper spray, rubber bullets, and force to disperse the crowd.
demands: Resignation of Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez
Resignation of transport minister Oscar Puente
response: According to Daily Mail, riot control officers used pepper spray and rubber bullets to push back and disperse the crowd outside the Ministry of Transport.

updates.text: A demonstration began near Nuevos Ministerios before escalating into clashes with riot police outside the Ministry of Transport.
